common.footerAbout: Interactive 3D models of the Osmaniye Korkut Ata University campus, produced from photogrammetry scans. Inspect buildings from every angle, measure them and place them in your own space on supported devices.
common.footerPrivacy: No cookies. Usage measurement consists of anonymous event counts only; IP addresses and browser details are never stored, and your browser’s Do Not Track setting is respected.
common.footerData: Building information is compiled from the university’s public web pages.
common.offlineToast: You are offline; showing saved content.
common.updateReady: A new version is ready and will load next time.
common._note_langHint: Dil önerisi diğer dilde yazılır: bu sayfanın dilini konuşmayan ziyaretçiye gösterilir.

home.title: OKÜ Digital Campus — explore the campus in 3D
home.description: Explore the Osmaniye Korkut Ata University campus and its buildings through interactive 3D models made from photogrammetry scans; find them on the map and place them in your space with AR.
home.heroLead: 3D models of Osmaniye Korkut Ata University buildings, produced from real scans. Rotate, zoom and measure — and on supported phones, bring a model onto your desk with augmented reality.
home.heroStageAria: Open the campus master plan in the 3D viewer
home.heroPosterAlt: Overview of the OKÜ campus from its 3D scan
home.catalogTitle: Pick a building and start exploring.
home.catalogNote: Each model opens in a light version first; detail streams in as you zoom.
home.cardSizeTitle: Light version downloaded on first open
home.arBadgeReady: AR is available on this device
home.emptyText: Try a different name or clear the category filter.
home.mapLead: The map is not a drawing: it is a top-down render of the campus master plan model. Building positions were measured by image matching and checked by eye.
home.mapImageAlt: Aerial view of the OKÜ Karacaoğlan Campus
home.howTitle: Open a model — everything else is at your fingertips.

howItems.title: Rotate and zoom
howItems.text: Drag to rotate, pinch or scroll to zoom. A more detailed level loads automatically as you get closer.

howItems.title: Camera presets
howItems.text: Jump between perspective, façade, bird’s-eye and plan views with one tap, or start the cinematic tour.

howItems.title: Measure and capture
howItems.text: Measure the distance between two points, save a signed screenshot and share a link to exactly what you are looking at.

howItems.title: See it in your space
howItems.text: On supported Android and iOS devices, place the model on your desk or floor with augmented reality.

howItems.title: Use it offline
howItems.text: Save a building to your device and it opens without a connection. The site can also be installed as an app.

howItems.title: Find it on the map
howItems.text: Pick a building on the campus map, see where it is and get directions with one tap.

home.installText: Open the campus like an app and save buildings for offline use.
home.fileProtocol: 3D models cannot be opened over file:// for security reasons. Use a local server: python3 -m http.server 8000

map.title: Campus map
map.description: Find buildings on an aerial plan of the OKÜ campus and jump to their 3D models and building pages.
map.lead: The plan is a top-down render of the campus master plan model. Pick a building to see where it is and jump to its 3D model or building page.
map.outsideNote: {names} is outside the area covered by this plan, so it is not shown on the map.
map.viewportLabel: Campus map: drag to pan, use + and − to zoom
map.imageAlt: Aerial view of the OKÜ Karacaoğlan Campus with buildings marked
map.help: Drag · scroll or pinch to zoom · keyboard: arrows, + / − and 0
map.unconfirmed: This building's map position was found by image matching and has not been confirmed yet.
map.imageError: The map image could not be loaded. Check your connection and reload the page.
map.editorHint: Pick a building from the list, then click its position on the plan. Add the generated values to the model's "map" field in models.json.

viewer.title: 3D viewer
viewer.description: Inspect OKÜ campus buildings as interactive 3D models and place them in your own space with AR on supported devices.
viewer.errorTitle: The model could not be opened
viewer.errorLoad: The model could not be downloaded or your device could not render it. Check your connection and try again.
viewer.errorMissing: The building in this link is no longer in the catalogue. See the buildings page for the current list.
viewer.errorNoModel: No building was specified. Pick one from the buildings page.
viewer.errorUnsafe: This model link is not valid. Pick the building again from the buildings page.
viewer.errorFile: This page does not work over file://. Use a local server: python3 -m http.server 8000
viewer.errorWebgl: Your browser does not support 3D graphics (WebGL) or has it disabled. Try again with an up-to-date browser.
viewer.fallbackTrying: The optimised version could not be opened; trying the standard version…
viewer.mapTip: Show this building on the campus map

tourStops.title: Overview
tourStops.text: See the building with its surroundings; drag at any time to take control.

tourStops.title: Façade
tourStops.text: An eye-level look at the main façade.

tourStops.title: Bird’s-eye
tourStops.text: Roofs and massing from an oblique angle.

tourStops.title: Plan
tourStops.text: Top-down view: the layout and the grounds around it.

viewer.tourCampusIntro: Campus tour: visiting the buildings one by one.
viewer.arTip: Place the model in your own space with your camera
viewer.arDesktop: AR only works on supported phones and tablets. Open this page with Chrome on Android or Safari on iPhone/iPad.
viewer.arInsecure: AR requires the page to be opened over HTTPS.
viewer.arNotSupported: AR was not found on this device. On Android, “Google Play Services for AR” must be installed and the page opened in Chrome; it does not work in in-app browsers.
viewer.arNeedsModel: Wait for the model to load before checking AR support.
viewer.arReadyTap: AR is ready. Tap the AR button again to start.
viewer.arPlaced: Model placed. Pinch with two fingers to resize it.
viewer.arStartHint: Point your camera at a flat surface.
viewer.arPreparingText: Slowly move your camera left and right over the floor.
viewer.arTrackingText: Point at a brighter, textured floor and move the phone slowly.

arStatus.tapToPlace: Tap a surface to place the model.
arStatus.waitingStable: Waiting for the device to settle before {tier} quality…
arStatus.keepQuality: Keeping the current quality for smooth AR.
arStatus.fpsDrop: Frame rate dropped; returning to a smoother quality…
arStatus.keptPrevious: Kept the previous quality for smooth AR.
arStatus.upgradeFailed: Detail could not be upgraded; keeping the current model.
arStatus.loadFailed: The model could not be loaded in AR.
arStatus.placed: Model placed. Drag with one finger; pinch and twist with two.
arStatus.pinch: Pinch to resize and twist to rotate.
arStatus.moving: Moving the model along the floor…
arStatus.positionReady: Position set. Drag with one finger; pinch and twist with two.
arStatus.tapReticle: Tap where the ring appears to place the model.
arStatus.surfaceFound: Surface found; preparing the light model…
arStatus.starting: Starting the camera and surface detection…
arStatus.scanFloor: Slowly move your camera left and right over the floor.

viewer.shareQrAlt: QR code of the share link
viewer.shareQrHint: Scan the QR code with your phone camera to open the model at the same angle — the easiest way into AR.
viewer.sharePage: Copy the building page link (with preview)
viewer.shareCopyFailed: Copy failed; select the link and copy it manually.
viewer.campusHint: Tap a building label for details; the Tour button visits the campus building by building.
viewer.helpQualityText: Models open at the light level; as you zoom in, the medium and high levels are prepared in the background and switched in automatically. The quality chip at the top right shows the active level; tap it to see the details and lock a quality.
viewer.qualityAria: Model quality: {tier}. Activate to see the details.
viewer.tierWaiting: The detailed level is downloading in the background…
viewer.tierRecovered: The detailed level could not be opened; keeping the previous model.
viewer.savingData: Data saver is on: detailed levels are not downloaded automatically; you can raise the quality here.
viewer.offlineUnsupported: Offline storage is not available in this browser.
viewer.offlineSaved: This building is saved on your device and opens without a connection.
viewer.offlinePartial: Part of this building is saved. Continue to complete it.
viewer.offlineNone: Download every quality level to your device and open it without a connection.
viewer.offlineFailed: Saving did not finish. Check your connection and free space, then try again; downloaded files are kept.
viewer.arAvailable: AR is available on this device.
viewer.sourcesNote: Compiled from the university’s public web pages; not separately verified per building.
viewer.noFacts: Units, floors, area and location have not been added for this building yet.
viewer.mapUnconfirmed: The map position was found by image matching and has not been confirmed yet.
viewer.measureHintScaled: Tap two points. The result is approximate, depending on scan accuracy (±2%).
viewer.measureHintUnscaled: Tap two points. This model has no defined real-world scale, so the result is in model units; you can calibrate once with a known length.
viewer.measurePrompt: What is the real distance between the two points in metres? (pick a known length: a door, a façade, a parking bay)
viewer.measureSaved: Scale saved in this browser. To make it permanent, add "scan": {"metersPerUnit": {value}} to models.json.
viewer.measureMiss: No model surface there; tap a little further inside.
viewer.snapshotFailed: The screenshot could not be taken.
viewer.snapshotNotReady: Screenshots are available once the model has loaded.
viewer.editorHint: Click a point on the model and type a label. Paste the JSON below into the model's hotspots field in models.json.
